name: the-humans-control-surface
title: The human control surface
scope: How the commander expects to see and steer a run: local web pages over the JSON documents rather than a command line. Excludes the pilot cockpit that reports to them (see the-pilot-role).

statements.statement: my highest focus is on getting the JSON underpinings correct as an 'interface' that i can connect to (built later, out of scope here) with a local web server that will become my control surface rather than a CLI.
statements.context: Opening brief for the flightcrew-core rebuild, naming the highest priority for the run.

statements.statement: It can be a live doc, that when a web page layers over the top they can get realtime updates, flip gates etc.
statements.context: On what a launch document becomes once a page is layered over it.

statements.statement: local web page writing to launch.json or spec.json as far more palatable for a user than remembering 15 commands + flags.
statements.context: Explaining why the runner must not become the control surface.

statements.statement: user facing commands removed. user wants local web page overlay reading run assets directly able to mutate.
statements.context: Checking that the known big changes had survived into the problem register.

statements.statement: visibility is huge, although that will be a separate spec, but need interfaces that aren't "locked up"
statements.context: Naming what else belonged in the intent, while accepting it might not make the cut.

statements.statement: a launcher script in the cockpit is fine for now, the end game is a launcher inside a HUD page.
statements.context: Answering the pilot's five day-one questions about cockpit tooling.
